reason: $89 a month is almost 8% of what I earn in a month, and Bitrix24 has a free plan. I run everything from Telegram and a notebook and it works, so I would take the free trial at most and not pay.
objection: $89 a month is a lot when Bitrix24 is free, and I have never used a CRM, so I do not know it would earn that money back. Only 1 to 5 companies pay for it and there are no references.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 to $20 a month, or a free plan that works. A company I know in Tashkent showing me it brought them more sales would also help.
